name: Benten-chan
source:
A goddess of beauty, using "fate" to help women on their quests for beauty. (Not the same Benten as the one of the seven gods of luck.)

Called Benten-chan by the other gods, due to her favorably comparing other women to the original goddess Benten. She adores women, and is the owner of a crossdressing butler cafe. (As in, handsome girls dressed as butlers.) Using her powers of changing humans' appearance, she helps Fuuka temporarily return her body to that of an adult.
